newsitem.title: REPUBLIC OF IRELAND: Greencore says to outstrip 96/97 sugar quota.
newsitem.headline: Greencore says to outstrip 96/97 sugar quota.

text.p: Irish food and agribusiness company Greencore Group plc said on Thursday it expects to produce more than its 200,200 tonne quota in its 1996-1997 sugar campaign.
The company said the 1996/97 campaign s progressing well and the outlook is to produce in excess of its quota of 200,200 tonnes with beet sugar content and yields being above average.

The recent irish green pound revaluation will adversely impact both the company and our growers although a continuing production efficiency programme should mean a satisfactory result for the campaigh as a whole, it said.
The 1996 harvest resulted in high cereal volumes and excellent quality malting barley and the reduction of cereal set-aside from 10 percent to five percent in 1997 will be helpful, it said.
Greencore said its consumer foods and flour businesses will be helped by the strengthening of the pound sterling against the Irish pound. -- Dublin Newsroom +353-1-6613377
